dct_description_sm:
Overview

This feature service provides building footprint features for Peachland, British Columbia. It supports a detailed view of building locations and outlines across the community, with attribute information describing building type and basic height and elevation characteristics.

Feature Layers
  • Peachland Buildings — Polygon building footprints with descriptive attributes for building type and structure details, including height and elevation measurements that can support planning, visualization, and 3D modeling workflows.
Geographic Coverage

The dataset covers the Peachland area in the Regional District of Central Okanagan, British Columbia, and is attributed to the GIS Section of the Regional District of Central Okanagan.

Use Cases
  • Base mapping and building inventory analysis
  • Urban planning and land use reference
  • 3D scene and building height visualization
  • Community asset mapping and development review
Access and Licensing

Access is provided under the Regional District of Central Okanagan open data license and disclaimer terms.
